text:
tara: quick note — saw a ~3x p50 increase on /v1/embeddings when a single request mixed 1536 and 4096-dim vectors in one batch. repro on canary infra.

sam: hmm. you mean a single payload with two items of different dims?

tara: yeah, client sent an array: 
```json
[ {"dims":1536, "text":"..."}, {"dims":4096, "text":"..."} ]
```
No crash, just huge tokenization + KV setup overhead and then routing into two different execution paths that can't be coalesced -> batching ineffective.

maria: that's expected but we need better telemetry to surface this. current metrics show request size and item count, but not per-item dim distribution.

noah: could do per-request histogram of dims (e.g., max/min/unique-count) sampled at 1/1000 and 1/100 for errors. cheap and helps debugging.

ingress-bot: alert: embeddings-route latency anomaly detected (p50 +120% over baseline) — source=canary-3 region=us-west2.

sam: propose two immediate mitigations: 1) client-side validation in SDKs to fail-fast mixed-dim batches with a helpful error + link to docs; 2) server-side soft-heuristic that auto-splits mixed-dim requests into sub-batches but only for small requests to avoid overhead.

devex-bot: suggested copy for SDK error: "Mixed vector dimensionalities detected. Split your batch or call separate /embeddings routes per dimension. See https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings#dims"

console-team: also want a dashboard tile: `per-request dim distribution` (heatmap) + `mixed-dim rate` so PMs can see how often clients do this. add a chart that links to sample traces.

maria: telemetry sampling plan: capture per-request dim-summary fields (max,min,cardinality) at 1/500 default, bump to 1/100 for requests with p95 latency > SLO. label with `splitter_candidate=true/false`. keep payload small (~20 bytes).

noah: pricing/quota angle: current per-embedding unit assumes fixed dim pricing. mixed dims make cost attribution weird. we should consider a unified quota calc that charges by bytes of model input (approx dims * float_size) instead of count-based units. backwards-compatible mapping required.

sam: agree but product needs a migration plan — can't break existing per-unit dashboards and invoices. maybe alpha behind feature-flag for Dedicated customers first.

tara: for rollout: 1) patch SDKs with client-side validation (canary tomorrow), 2) server telemetry + dashboard (maria + console-team) in 2 weeks, 3) soft-splitter heuristic (noisy canary) after telemetry, 4) unified quota proposal doc for PM/finance.

console-team: i'll add a mockup for the heatmap + per-dim cost estimator in the console backlog. want a toggle to show costs under old vs new quota math.

maria: can someone open a single tracking issue with these 4 workstreams and assign owners? i'll own the telemetry piece.

noah: i'll draft the quota proposal and include examples for mixed [1536,4096] and variable-length tokenization costs.

sam: i'll take SDK changes + canary plan.

tara: thanks — tagging @sam @maria @noah. if anyone sees more anomalies, paste a short trace (span ids) and i'll attach. :thumbsup:
